message.content:
The largest planet that has been observed so far is **HD 100546 b**.  
It is a young, forming planet orbiting the star HD 100546, and it has a radius of roughly **2.5–3 times that of Jupiter**. This makes it the biggest planet we have detected in the entire observable universe.
